from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
import random
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

spark = SparkSession.builder.getOrCreate()
### JDBC CONNECTION TO SQL SERVER DATABASE

metadata = (
    spark.read
         .jdbc(
             url=jdbc_url,
             table="metadata",
             properties=connection_properties
         )
         .filter(F.col("source_name") == "customer")
         .first()
)

landing_path = metadata.source_path

# Lookup Data
first_names = ["Rohan","Amit","Rahul","Arjun","Kiran","Priya","Sneha","Anita","Neha","Pooja"]

last_names = ["Sharma","Patel","Reddy","Nayak","Das","Singh","Verma","Gupta","Nair","Joshi"]

genders = ["Male", "Female"]

cities = {
    "Bengaluru": "Karnataka",
    "Hyderabad": "Telangana",
    "Chennai": "Tamil Nadu",
    "Mumbai": "Maharashtra",
    "Pune": "Maharashtra",
    "Kolkata": "West Bengal",
    "Delhi": "Delhi"
}

customer_statuses = ["Active", "Inactive"]

email_domains = ["gmail.com", "yahoo.com", "outlook.com"]

street_names = [
    "MG Road",
    "Brigade Road",
    "Park Street",
    "Anna Salai",
    "Banjara Hills",
    "Ring Road"

customer_data = []

for i in range(1, 1001):

    city = random.choice(list(cities.keys()))

    customer_data.append({
        "customer_id": f"CUST{i:06d}",
        "first_name": random.choice(first_names),
        "last_name": random.choice(last_names),
        "date_of_birth": (datetime.now() - timedelta(days=random.randint(18 * 365, 70 * 365))).date(),
        "gender": random.choice(genders),
        "email": f"customer{i}@{random.choice(email_domains)}",
        "phone_number": f"9{random.randint(100000000, 999999999)}",
        "address": f"{random.randint(1,999)}, {random.choice(street_names)}",
        "city": city,
        "state": cities[city],
        "zip_code": str(random.randint(100000, 999999)),
        "customer_status": random.choice(customer_statuses),
        "created_date": datetime.now(),
        "last_updated_ts": datetime.now()
### Writing customer data to ADLS landing zone as a csv file.
